messages.content:
<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Misleading network failure error message",
 "problem_statement": "Users encounter error messages that incorrectly suggest a Keelwater system bug when the issue is actually a customer network failure. This confusion misdirects troubleshooting efforts and undermines trust in the platform's reliability."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 1,
 "mentions_n": 1,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "support": 1
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 1600000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 1,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Marrowgate Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": 1600000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2026-12-12",
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "ed5326045ffa63e4",
  "quote": "it’s definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug.",
  "account": "Marrowgate Commercial",
  "route": "support",
  "date": "2026-10-27T11:53:00+00:00"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{"body_md": "## Problem

Users see error messages that wrongly suggest a Keelwater system bug when the real cause is a customer network failure. The confusion sends troubleshooting in the wrong direction and weakens confidence in the platform's reliability.

## Who is affected

- Marrowgate Commercial, an account with 1600000.0 in ARR and a renewal on 2026-12-12, raised this through the support route [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].
- Across the fact sheet, 1 accounts, 1 mentions and 1 routes are recorded, with 1 renewals in the next 90 days [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].

## Evidence

- A Marrowgate Commercial contact reported that it was definitely a customer network failure, not Keelwater being down, though the error message makes it sound like a bug [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].
- The mention is logged on 2026-10-27 through the support route, the only route represented in the fact sheet [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].
- The fact sheet covers 1 accounts and 1 mentions as of 2026-11-03, so the signal is narrow and comes from a single account [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].

## Why now

- Marrowgate Commercial renews on 2026-12-12, and the account carries 1600000.0 in ARR, so the misread error message lands close to a renewal decision [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].
- The only recorded mention is from 2026-10-27, and no insight in the fact sheet points the other way, so the evidence is consistent but limited to this account [i:ed5326045ffa63e4].
", "citations": ["ed5326045ffa63e4"]}
